categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet label and changes to src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp validating options for the sendall RPC.
categories.rationale: Strict option validation prevents silent misconfiguration that could inadvertently spend all wallet UTXOs or broadcast unfinalized transactions. As noted in the description, misspelling 'inputs' as 'input' causes sendall to spend all available wallet UTXOs rather than the requested subset, and typos in 'add_to_wallet' or 'psbt' can cause unintended broadcast.
